title: Match workflow versions to recorded execution history
requiredVisibleLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Replay durable execution history under different versions; identify the valid version-match strategy.
exactSourceBehavior: Pin or explicitly version long-lived workflows so new code does not invalidate existing execution history.
exactParentAcceptance: Existing histories continue under the correct version strategy; unexpected replay/history behavior is detected.
preconditions: Standalone modern browser, local JavaScript; no server, account, credentials or Azure resource.
Two fixed synthetic histories started under version 1.0; one started under version 2.0.
Version 2.0 inserts RiskCheck before ReserveStock; a short shared prefix alone is not continuation compatibility.
Explicit version branching is a curated preserved-definition fixture, not automatic version negotiation.
actions: Choose exact pinning, explicit version branching, or unversioned latest code.
Retain or remove the old worker; choose complete, missing, or incompatible recorded history.
Compare per-instance recorded commands, selected worker/definition and the next-command gate.
Inspect measurable PASSED, FAILED and UNKNOWN outcomes while retaining earlier comparisons.
Operate using keyboard controls, inspect focused errors and reset the bounded in-memory rehearsal.
syntheticInputAndTrace: Three fixed command-prefix fixtures in model.js. No real engine, activities, actual execution history or storage is accessed.
expectedAssertions: Exact pins with retained workers and explicit preserved-version branches permit modeled continuation.
Unversioned latest code exposes a recorded-command mismatch and blocks an incompatible next command.
Removing a required pinned worker blocks old work; a version label cannot repair incompatible history.
Unknown observations stay in the three-started denominator; known failures dominate unknowns.
Strict inputs, immutable validated state and a six-attempt guard preserve prior results.
Actual DOM, keyboard, error, reset, failure and CSP checks pass with the published isolated browser helper.

bounds.history: Memory only; cleared by explicit reset or page reload.

iac.sequence: After genuine loadable-stub assertion RED; before behavioral implementation.
iac.reason: No resources are created; cloud/IaC/scaffold/identity/deploy/spend are not authorized.

testRuntime.lifecycle: openIsolatedLesson and awaited close in finally; abandoned lifecycle prototype is unqualified.

limits: Portable deterministic model only, not actual durable engine replay, durable storage, activity or worker execution.
No native Azure, production Node.js 24, completed workflow, source-parent completion or five-nines certification.
B-S058, D-S058 and P004 remain separate and incomplete.
No real authentication, identity registration, credentials, management calls or external effects.
No cloud, IaC, scaffold, deployment, expenditure, package/framework install, download, unsafe flag or foreground lease.
Only learning/S058 is owned; no root/shared changes or extra test/plumbing/refinement units.
